english.title: Reverse a motor vehicle unnecessarily on a road
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), backwards on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), further than necessary for the safety or reasonable convenience of the occupants of the vehicle or other traffic.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 106 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) Road rollers and motor vehicles engaged in the construction, maintenance or repair of a road are exempt.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wordings: H245 and H246.
(iv) Additional information may be included in the Statement of Facts, i.e. detail of any excessive speed/other aggravating features.
(v) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
